title: Conceptual Ecosystem
definition: A broad conceptual framework that represents the interconnectedness and dynamic relationships between different knowledge systems and their users.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as a living garden. You plant seeds, nurture connections, and harvest insights, just like tending a mycelial garden.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The conceptual ecosystem is a knowledge graph that includes various concepts, their interrelations, and the context in which they are created and used. It reflects the collective intellectual efforts of a community.
difficulty_levels.expert: The conceptual ecosystem is not just a collection of information, but a dynamic system that mirrors the intellectual landscape. It enables cross-disciplinary connections, supports lifelong learning, and preserves ideas with cryptographic certainty. The ecosystem will eventually evolve to integrate with AI, enabling knowledge discovery and collaboration.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES knowledge system is a living, evolving conceptual ecosystem that reflects the intellectual landscape and supports the collective knowledge creation and use of its community.
